A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
for $p$ an odd prime and $p \equiv3\pmod{4}$, we construct asymptotically good LCD and self dual codes over $\mathbb{Z}_p^2$.

for $p \equiv3 \pmod 4$ we obtain asymptotically good families of self dual and $p^2-1$-ary LCD double circulant self dual codes, and when $p \equiv1 \pmod 8$ we obtain asymptotic performance of $p^2+1$-ary self dual double circulant codes, which are also LCD.
we construct a large number of asymptotically optimal self dual and LCD binary codes with respect to the Hamming metric and the Lee metric.
The main takeaway from our work is that
self dual and LCD constructions over Galois rings are not only possible, but can be made to have good performance.
the existence of a duality preserving Gray map from \mathbb{G}R(2,p^2) to $\mathbb{Z}_ {p^2}$ is the key ingredient to construct asymptotically good families of self dual and self dual LCD codes.
self dual and LCD properties are not mutually exclusive.
